text:
Ana P.: quick context — roadmap decision jam. Need final gating criteria for multi-region + tenant isolation for Q3 launch. Customer asks: per-tenant regional pinning, hard data residency, soft fallbacks. Who owns routing policy vs isolation vs ops runbook?

Miguel R.: I can own routing policy. Heads-up: per-tenant pinning == capacity fragmentation. We need either reservation APIs or a strict commit model. :thinking_face:

Chris L.: infra note: routing + isolation changes autoscaler/binpacking behavior. Strict region pinning requires reservations + quota UI. Expect p50/p95 latency delta ~ +6–15ms depending on fanout.

Sarah J.: from PM side — prioritizing FinCorp and HealthCo requests. Proposed gating: must support tenant.region pin, publish SLA + egress controls, and a canary rollout with ops rollback playbook.

Ana P.: propose launch gates: 1) API for tenant.region pin, 2) infra: reservation + fallback policy implemented, 3) SLOs defined with regression thresholds, 4) Security: regional KMS + audit logs, 5) Runbook: documented playbooks + oncall rotation. Comments?

Miguel R.: add automated perf guards — CI perf tests against representative workloads. Fail -> block rollout. Also need telemetry: cost attribution by tenant+region tags.

Chris L.: config sketch (for discussion):

```
tenant_pinning:
  mode: soft | hard
  preferred_regions: [us-west-2, eu-west-1]
  fallback_policy: relocate | queue | route-to-hosted
```

Sarah J.: +1. For prioritization: phased rollout: Phase A = enterprise SLA customers (manual opt-in), Phase B = self-serve accounts (quota-limited), Phase C = open. Move from A->B requires revenue/usage signal.

infra-bot: deploy-check: canary cluster for "tenant-pinning" feature is healthy. e2e tests: 12/15 passing. :white_check_mark:

Ana P.: action items: Miguel draft routing design doc by Mon (please drop link in thread), Chris draft reservation/quota API by Wed, Sarah produce launch criteria checklist + customer comms draft. I'll schedule a 30m sync Thurs. @channel flag blockers early.

Chris L.: decision-needed: does fallback 'route-to-hosted' require cross-region KV replication? If yes, heavy ops cost. We should decide now.

Miguel R.: noted — will include cost model options (replication vs degrade-to-queue vs regional-hosted fallback).

Sarah J.: I'll compile acceptance criteria and the customer opt-in flow today.

Ana P.: thanks all. :rocket:
